name: study-notebook
description: Lets Claude keep your Study Notebook up to date while you study, turn recorded lectures into notes, and prepare exam practice.
long_description:
Study normally by talking with Claude. When you understand something, Claude saves the final explanation into your **Study Notebook**, under the right course, topic and sub-topic. If you didn't understand a section, Claude rewrites just that section.

Works with the Study Notebook app on this computer. If the app is open, changes appear in it instantly; if it's closed, they appear the next time you open it. Your notes never leave your computer through this extension.

tools.name: get_outline
tools.description: Show a course's notebook as a tree of sections

tools.name: save_section
tools.description: Save or update an explanation in your notebook

tools.name: save_sections
tools.description: Save many explanations at once, e.g. all the notes from a PDF or lecture

tools.name: edit_part
tools.description: Replace one part of a saved section with a deeper or clearer version, leaving the rest unchanged.

tools.name: list_lectures
tools.description: List recorded lectures in a course
